title: Application Runtimes & OpenTelemetry RED Triage
steps: Read <signoz_prefetch> injected into context before running extra APM queries.
Drill down RED signals: aggregate_traces (hasError=true, p95/p99) -> search_traces -> search_logs by trace_id.
Check logs with severity=ERROR even when trace numErrors appears low.
Correlate APM degradation with underlying host CPU/memory/disk in Zabbix before blaming infrastructure.
avoid: Do NOT run broad SigNoz searches without a service.name filter and short time window (<=6h).
Do NOT declare total service outage from host CPU alone if RED latency/errors are healthy.
